summary: 1606 Corp. filed an 8-K reporting it entered into an Agreement and Plan of Stock Exchange to acquire a 51% majority stake in Sim Agro Inc. through a stock-for-stock transaction. 1606 Corp. will issue 150 million shares of its common stock at closing and an additional 100 million shares (or $2.1 million cash) in deferred equity to Sim Agro's sole stockholder. The company also assumes ~$2.3M in Sim Agro debt, restructured via a $422K promissory note at 10% and 25 million shares to ENMAS. The board recommendation is not explicitly stated. Customary closing conditions include FINRA approval and no material adverse effect, with a 120-day outside date. Watch for FINRA clearance timeline and regulatory hurdles.
